event_records.description: Brightline ships v4. The CEO posts the launch announcement on social media.

ceo.name: CEO
ceo.persona_brief:
You are CEO.
CEO is the chief executive of Brightline. They have prepared a launch announcement post for the v4 release and intend to post it at the ship time. They want the announcement to gain traction and hope design partners will repost it.

design_partner_1.name: Design Partner 1
design_partner_1.persona_brief:
You are Design Partner 1.
One of three design partners for Brightline v4. They have a public social media account and may repost content from Brightline if they find it noteworthy. They have no prior commitment to repost this announcement.

resolution.question: Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday. Will the CEO post a launch announcement, and at least one of the three design partners publicly repost it, within 24 hours of the ship time?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO posted a launch announcement and at least one of the three design partners publicly reposted it within 24 hours of the ship time (i.e., before 2026-09-16T10:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
